## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS
* **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. Inline event handlers (`onclick="..."`) are also forbidden.
* **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states must be targeted via class or ID selectors in `style.css`.
* **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML must remain clean, semantic, and style-agnostic — changing the look requires editing only the CSS file.

### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens
Store every visual token in `:root` (mirrored under `.dark`, applied to `<html>`). Use exactly this token sheet:

```css
:root, .dark {
  /* Colors */
  --primary: #39d353;         /* Terminal Green — accents, cursor, links */
  --secondary: #238636;       /* Muted Green — solid action surfaces */
  --bg-primary: #0d1117;      /* GitHub Dark — page background */
  --bg-secondary: #161b22;    /* Code BG — cards, panels, code blocks */
  --text-primary: #e6edf3;    /* White Text */
  --text-secondary: #8b949e;  /* Dim Text */
  --text-success: #39d353;
  --text-error: #f85149;      /* GitHub Dark error red — palette-coherent */
  --border-default: #30363d;
  --border-success: #39d353;
  --border-error: #f85149;

  /* Code syntax tokens (GitHub Dark scheme) */
  --syntax-keyword: #ff7b72;
  --syntax-string: #a5d6ff;
  --syntax-function: #d2a8ff;
  --syntax-comment: #8b949e;
  --syntax-constant: #79c0ff;

  /* Shape, depth, motion */
  --radius-sm: 4px;  --radius-md: 6px;  --radius-lg: 8px;
  --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  --glow-primary: 0 0 24px rgba(57, 211, 83, 0.25);
  --spacing-gap: 1.5rem;
  --transition-fast: 150ms;   /* Theme mandate: 150ms transitions */
  --transition-normal: 150ms;
  --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

  /* Layering */
  --z-dropdown: 1000;
  --z-modal: 1100;
  --z-toast: 1200;
  --z-scanlines: 1300;        /* Decorative overlay only */

  /* Type */
  --font-base: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
}
```

* **Contrast Pairing:** Every dark background token pairs with a light text token; the bright green button surface (`#39d353`) is a light background and must pair with dark text (`#0d1117`). Verify all text/background pairs meet WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1).

### 1.3 Dark Mode — Dark-Only Theme Exception
* Dark tokens are defined in `:root` and mirrored under a `.dark` class on `<html>`, keeping the token architecture consistent.
* **Exception clause (explicit):** Per the theme specification, this is a dark-only design. No light-mode palette, no `prefers-color-scheme` overrides, no theme toggle, and no `localStorage` persistence are required — the dark palette is the single, permanent theme. All contrast and accessibility requirements apply to this dark palette.

### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment
* Build all layout structures with Flexbox.
* **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment (e.g., card text columns use `flex-start` for reading flow).
* **Mobile-Friendly First:** All flex rows convert to columns below 768px. Fluid sizing via `clamp()`. No horizontal scrolling at any viewport width down to 320px.

### 1.5 Framework & Styling Approach
* Use Tailwind CSS or clean custom CSS organized with `@layer`/`@apply`. Given the bespoke terminal effects, a single custom `style.css` driven by the token system is acceptable and preferred.
* All utility classes must map back to CSS variables or semantic, reusable component classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)
* **Text:** Load JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts (weights 400, 500, 700, 800) via `<link>` and bind it to `--font-base`. Apply it globally — `html`, `body`, headings, buttons, inputs, and footer. No secondary font exists in this theme.
* **Icons:** Use Google Material Symbols (Rounded or Outlined) via Google Fonts. **Explicitly forbidden:** raw inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji as icons.
* Suggested icon names: `terminal`, `bolt`, `lock`, `code`, `check`, `close`, `content_copy`, `expand_more`, `menu`, `arrow_forward`, `error`, `progress`.

### 1.7 Mandatory Signature Effects
* **Scan lines overlay:** fixed, full-viewport, `pointer-events: none`, `z-index: var(--z-scanlines)`:
```css
.scan-lines {
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,
    transparent, transparent 2px,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 2px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 4px);
}
```
It must never reduce legibility or block interaction.
* **Blinking cursor:** `.cursor-blink { animation: blink 1s step-end infinite }` with `@keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0 } }`. Render as a green block cursor (inline-block box, `background: var(--primary)`); mark it `aria-hidden="true"`.
* **Terminal borders:** `.terminal-border { border: 1px solid var(--border-default) }`.
* **Code blocks:** `pre code { background: var(--bg-secondary); padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-md) }` with token classes `.tok-kw`, `.tok-str`, `.tok-fn`, `.tok-com`, `.tok-const` bound to the `--syntax-*` variables. `pre` uses `overflow-x: auto` so long lines never cause page-level horizontal scroll.
* **Transitions:** all state changes use `transition: var(--transition-fast) var(--ease-standard)` (150ms per theme mandate).
* **Polish:** `::selection { background: var(--primary); color: #0d1117 }`; global `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px }`.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

### 2.1 Buttons
* **Base `.btn`:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px, monospace, `border-radius: var(--radius-sm)`.
* **Variants:** `.btn--primary` (background `var(--primary)`, color `#0d1117`, bold); `.btn--secondary` (transparent, 1px `var(--border-default)` border, `var(--text-primary)` text; hover: border and text turn `var(--primary)`); `.btn--danger` (border `var(--border-error)`, text `var(--text-error)` — visually distinct in the dark theme).
* **Hover:** brightness shift and/or `var(--glow-primary)` shadow, `cursor: pointer`.
* **Focus:** distinct green focus ring via `:focus-visible` — never remove outlines.
* **Active:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
* **Loading `.btn--loading`:** `aria-busy="true"`, pointer events disabled to prevent double-clicks, CSS spinner (green border-based) or rotating Material Symbol `progress` — button dimensions must not shift.
* **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale filter, `cursor: not-allowed`, no hover transforms.
* **Success/Error feedback:** temporary `.btn--success` / `.btn--error` states driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`, announced via `aria-live`.

### 2.2 Cards
* **Default `.card`:** Flexbox layout, `background: var(--bg-secondary)`, 1px `var(--border-default)` border, `border-radius: var(--radius-md)`, `box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)`.
* **Hover (interactive cards):** `transform: translateY(-2px)`, border shifts toward green, `box-shadow: var(--shadow-md), var(--glow-primary)`.
* **Focus-within:** card border turns `var(--primary)` when a child link/button receives focus.
* **Loading (Skeleton):** define `.skeleton` shimmer animation (linear-gradient sweep keyframes) to prevent layout jumps for any async content.
* **Empty State:** structured fallback with a Material Symbol icon and clear guidance text.

### 2.3 Forms & Inputs
* **Structure `.input-group`:** flex container wrapping a `<label for>`, the input, and a dedicated error feedback container with `aria-live="polite"`.
* **Input style:** `background: var(--bg-secondary)`, 1px `var(--border-default)` border, `var(--text-primary)` monospace text, min-height 44px, terminal prompt prefix (`$` or `>`) via `::before` on the wrapper.
* **States:** Empty, Focused (green border + `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(57,211,83,0.2)`), Filled, Valid (success border + `check` icon), Invalid (`--border-error` border, red error text, `error` icon, message text — never color alone), Disabled (`opacity: 0.5`, `cursor: not-allowed`), Read-only (dimmed background).

### 2.4 Modal / Popup (applies if any overlay is used, e.g., a demo modal)
* **States:** Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing — all animated via CSS transitions (opacity + `scale(0.97 → 1)`, 150ms).
* **UX:** centered flex container (`align-items: center; justify-content: center`), backdrop overlay `rgba(0,0,0,0.7)`, Material Symbol `close` button (min 44px), `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"`, keyboard focus trapping, focus returned to trigger on close, closes via `Esc` and overlay click.

### 2.5 FAQ Accordion
* Each item: a `<button class="faq-item__question">` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, linked to an answer region with matching `id`.
* Question styled with a green `>` prompt prefix via `::before`; Material Symbol `expand_more` rotates 180° when open.
* Answer reveal animated via CSS (e.g., `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` technique), 150ms. Fully keyboard operable; no mouse-only interactions.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

* **Responsive by Default:** centered max-width container (~1200px), fluid `clamp()` padding, verified at 320px with zero horizontal overflow.
* **Smooth Animations:** 150ms transitions on all state changes (color, border, box-shadow, transform, opacity). **`prefers-reduced-motion`:** disable the blink animation, typing effect, shimmer, and transforms — states must still change instantly and visibly.
* **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast across the dark palette. Never rely on color alone — pair every state with an icon, text, or border change. Semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section` with `aria-labelledby`, `footer`), a single `<h1>`, logical heading order, logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability, visible focus rings, and `aria-live` regions for all dynamic feedback (copy confirmation, form errors/success, loading).
* **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** every click, hover, focus, and submission triggers a visible state change.
* **Destructive Actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct from primary/secondary actions in the dark theme.
* **Touch Targets:** all interactive elements ≥ 44×44px.

## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

* **File Structure:** separate `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js`. No inline `<script>` blocks beyond a single deferred entry point (`<script src="script.js" defer></script>`). Google Fonts `<link>` tags for JetBrains Mono and Material Symbols in `<head>`.
* **Naming Convention:** BEM throughout (`.btn--primary`, `.terminal-window__title`, `.faq-item__answer`, `.card--featured`). Never mix conventions; Tailwind utilities, if used, are limited to layout scaffolding only.
* **Copy:** real, themed English copy for the invented product — lorem ipsum is prohibited. Placeholders are allowed only where content was genuinely left unspecified.
* **JavaScript (vanilla, no frameworks):** mobile nav toggle (with `aria-expanded`, closes on `Esc`/link click), FAQ accordion behavior, smooth anchor scrolling (respecting reduced motion), email form validation + simulated submit states, clipboard copy with fallback and `aria-live` feedback, and modal logic (focus trap, `Esc`, backdrop) if any overlay is used.
* **Completeness:** deliver the full landing page — all sections, all component states, both files valid and linked — on the first attempt.
